description: Heritage form profile gate (issue #670, slice H5): with the Heritage profile INACTIVE the `value of … for key` dictionary reader (`spec/grammar.md:217`'s `value-of-reader`) is rejected with `ol-unknown-command` at the `value` head. Data is active here — the dict literal `{ tom: 8 }` parses cleanly — proving Data ALONE does not unlock the reader: `spec/conformance.md:273` classifies `value of … for key` as Heritage (which `spec/conformance.md:301` says also needs Data). The reader has no single-word Core equivalent (its Core spelling is the `:d[:k]`/`:d.key` selector syntax), so the diagnostic carries no did-you-mean, only the `ol-unknown-command` no-candidate message (`spec/error-model.md:96`).
